randomize_env: randomize physical parameters of a minitaur gym environment using a config like all_params
randomize_masses: randomize the base and leg masses of a minitaur robot within a given ratio range
randomize_inertia: randomize the base and leg inertias of a minitaur robot within a given ratio range
randomize_latency: randomize the control latency of a minitaur robot within a given time range
randomize_motor_strength: randomize the motor strength ratios of a minitaur robot within a given ratio range
